description: Parses User Access Logging (SUM) databases on Windows Server (SystemIdentity.mdb, Current.mdb, ...).
usage: Parses User Access Logging (SUM) databases on Windows Server. Use it to see which client IPs and users accessed server roles and services over time.
limitation: User Access Logging exists only on Windows Server 2012 and later and keeps per-day counts, not full event detail.

parameters.label: SUM directory
parameters.description: Directory to process, looking for SystemIdentity.mdb, Current.mdb, etc.

parameters.label: Day-level details
parameters.description: Generate CSV with day level details.
